ios.desc:
CV Engineer is a free AI resume builder and CV maker app. Create an ATS-optimized resume and improve your writing with AI. Check your CV for mistakes before applying for jobs.

Build the perfect CV with professional resume templates, examples, and advice. Impress employers and get more job interviews.

- 6.1 million downloads
- Resume examples written by Matthew Callery, a former executive recruiter

HOW IT WORKS
Choose a professional CV template. Then follow step-by-step advice for each CV section. Finally, download your PDF resume!

Our resume creator helps students, graduates, career changers, and professionals in every industry with their job applications.

RESUME MAKER FEATURES:

* PROFESSIONAL RESUME TEMPLATES:
Recruiter-designed CV templates optimized for Applicant Tracking Systems. Create resumes that hiring managers and recruitment software can easily read.

* AI RESUME WRITING ASSISTANT:
Improve your CV with AI-powered suggestions. Rewrite work experience, personal statements, and skills to sound more professional. Includes spelling and grammar correction.

* RESUME SCAN - CHECK FOR CV MISTAKES:
Our ATS resume checker scans your CV for mistakes, readability issues, and ATS compatibility. Get actionable feedback to improve your resume.

* IMPORT YOUR EXISTING RESUME:
Import an existing PDF or Word resume and edit it in our CV maker app.

* EASY RESUME EDITING AND CV WRITING TOOLS:
Write and edit your CV while our resume builder app handles formatting. Use bullet points to highlight your experience.

* CREATE CUSTOM CV SECTIONS:
Add sections with custom titles to showcase experience beyond traditional CV sections.

* ADVICE ON WRITING EACH RESUME SECTION:
Advice from a recruiter on how to write each CV section. Make your resume easy to read.

* CV EXAMPLES TO GIVE YOU IDEAS:
Get inspiration from resume examples for nurses, healthcare professionals, construction workers, software developers, students, graduates, executives, and sales managers. Our intelligent resume creator works for every profession!

* DOWNLOAD AND SHARE YOUR RESUME PDF:
Save your CV in PDF format to your device. Share by email or send your curriculum vitae to contacts for feedback.

* WRITE YOUR RESUME IN ANOTHER LANGUAGE:
Our resume editor supports English, Spanish, Czech, Dutch, German, French, Indonesian, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Turkish, and Vietnamese.

* OTHER FEATURES:
- Edit font sizes and margins
- Add a photo to your CV
- CV editor works offline

show_hn.title: Show HN: Resume builder developed by former recruiter

quotes.text:
Hey all,

I've recently released an iOS resume builder designed to help people quickly put together a professional CV.

I previously worked as a recruitment consultant before completing an MSc Computer Science and wanted to share my experience with job seekers. The app contains advice and examples to guide users through the process.

Any feedback would be greatly appreciated!

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/cv-engineer-resume-builder/id1445323895?ls=1&mt=8
